pokedexEntries.bk: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

pokedexEntries.wh: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

pokedexEntries.sw: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.
